name: SealQA
description: SealQA is a challenge benchmark for evaluating search-augmented language models on fact-seeking questions with conflicting, noisy, or unhelpful web search results. It includes three variants: Seal-0 and Seal-Hard for factual accuracy and reasoning, and LongSeal for long-context, multi-document reasoning in difficult retrieval settings.
reputation: A recent benchmark that is gaining attention for stress-testing search-augmented LMs under noisy and conflicting retrieval conditions.
notes: Highlights limitations of current models on noisy search results and long-context reasoning; released on Huggingface.
